more_info.uses: EU permissions include processed eggs and egg products. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.side_effects:
EFSA found no concern for the assessed limited food uses.
Higher-dose animal studies identified nervous-system effects of aluminium.
more_info.overview: Aluminium sulphate is classified in food technology as a firming agent. Its technological role is to help maintain firmness.
